metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by mattdaco-dev: living specs, code audits and a development workflow.

plugins.name: living-specs
plugins.description: Grill a feature, then keep functional specs, screen specs, a business glossary and tickets in sync with the project.

plugins.name: code-audits
plugins.description: Security, performance, maintainability, GDPR and SEO audits, quarterly maintenance passes, legacy takeover and C4 architecture diagrams.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Session handover, architecture decision records, role-named subagents and a configurable git guard.

plugins.name: quiet-diffs
plugins.description: Collapse Edit, Write and shell-command diffs to one line with added and removed counts; ctrl+o still shows the full diff.
